title: Determination of Flavonoid Content
author: Jorge Carlos Ruiz Ruiz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sfnebme
materials: Catechin (Sigma-Aldrich) was used as the standard and the results were expressed as µg/mL of catechin equivalents (CE).

steps.title: Prepare sample solution
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 mL of the sample to 0.4 mL distilled water in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add sodium nitrite
steps.instruction: Add 0.03 mL of 5 % (w/v) NaNO₂ to the tube and allow the mixture to react for 5 min at ambient temperature.

steps.title: Add aluminum chloride
steps.instruction: Add 0.03 mL of 10 % (w/v) AlCl₃ to the mixture and let it stand for a further 5 min.

steps.title: Add carbonate and measure
steps.instruction: Add 0.2 mL of 1 M Na₂CO₃ and 0.24 mL distilled water to the reaction mixture, mix, then record the absorbance at 510 nm.
